sections.content: Schemas change in production — never ALTER by hand. Migration tools (Flyway, Liquibase, Alembic, Prisma Migrate) version schema changes as ordered scripts applied exactly once per environment.
Rules: every change is reversible or documented, never edit an applied migration, test migrations against production-like data, and keep them small and fast.
Key points: migrations run at deploy time, backfills for new NOT NULL columns need defaults, and rollbacks should be planned even if rarely used.
